labels.spya-shh76z: The Top of My Todo List
labels.spya-up3g9y: Bronnie Ware's list of dying people's regrets seems plausible to the author, who could make 4 of 5 mistakes
labels.spya-fvqhme: The 5 regrets paint a portrait of post-industrial man who shrinks to fit circumstances and turns dutifully till he stops
labels.spya-mwupnd: The mistakes producing these regrets are errors of omission, dangerous because made by default
labels.spya-ycfbkt: Since these mistakes happen by default, the author inverted the 5 regrets into 5 commands to be reminded
labels.spya-kr5gze: Don't ignore your dreams; don't work too much; say what you think; cultivate friendships; be happy
labels.spya-dn2fm3: The author put these commands at the top of his todo list file
